svg.text: Horizontal axis: real part of s (growth or decay). Vertical axis: imaginary part (oscillation rate).

svg.text: The real part sets the envelope: positive diverges, negative converges. The imaginary part sets rotation speed, and zero means no rotation at all.

svg.text: The trajectory of e^(st) in the complex plane is just these two effects combined.
